nodes.title: Nodes

nodes.noNodes: No nodes yet. Click “New Node” to get started.

users.title: Users
users.noUsers: No users yet. Click “New User” to create the first subscriber.
users.remarkHelper: Used to tell subscriptions apart in clients, and as the node account label
users.subscriptionPathHelper: Leave empty to generate. Letters, digits, - and _ only; editable later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subscriptionPrefixPinned: subscription_prefix is pinned in config.yml and used for links; edit the config file and restart to change it
settings.defaultTargetHelper: Used when the client cannot be detected from User-Agent
settings.disguisePageHelper: Saving an empty value restores the built-in page. Returned as ISO-8859-1 with a 404 status.

settings.disguisePageDisabled: Disable 404 passthrough to edit the static page.
settings.disguiseTemplateIpHelper: IP or hostname; skips DNS and connects directly when set
settings.disguiseTemplatePortHelper: 0 uses the port in the address
settings.adminPasswordNotice: Changing the password signs out every active session.
settings.passwordChangeSuccess: Password changed, please sign in again
settings.signOutDescription: The admin session on this device ends immediately.
settings.description: The disguise strategy applies to every public path, including invalid subscription links and common probe paths.
